name: fox
text: Beyond the Moonflower Meadow, a tiny fox named Pip found a seed glowing like a star. A sign said: “Kindness helps small things grow.” Should Pip visit the sleepy owl or cross the little bridge?

name: space
text: Nia the astronaut landed on a moon made of soft blue moss. Her robot, Button, spotted a silver garden and a trail of tiny footprints. Should they explore the garden or follow the footprints?

name: dragon
text: Bramble was a tiny dragon whose sneezes made bubbles. One morning, a cloud shaped like a pancake floated past his window. He packed a picnic basket. Should Bramble follow the cloud or visit the pond?
